image_description: A hammerhead shark swimming underwater in blue water, viewed from a frontal angle. The distinctive cephalofoil (hammer-shaped head) is clearly visible with eyes at the tips. The shark's body extends backward with visible pectoral fins and dorsal fin. The ventral side appears lighter than the dorsal side.

There is significant motion blur or depth-of-field blur on the trailing edges of the fins and the background rocks, which is common in underwater photography but could mask generation artifacts.
